actors.name: Marine Le Pen
actors.blurb: Marine Le Pen awaits a critical court ruling on July 7, 2026, that could determine her eligibility to run in France's 2027 presidential election. The verdict follows her 2025 conviction for misusing EU funds, which could result in a five-year ineligibility period. This decision is pivotal for the future of the far-right RN party, potentially paving the way for Jordan Bardella to take the lead.
